R155.note: Build FAILS: ResponseEntity.ResponseEntityBuilder is not a real type (Spring's nested builder is BodyBuilder), so the endpoint does not compile at all and the write-up does not flag this.

R156.note: Narrows ignoringRequestMatchers to /api/webhooks/** exactly matching the code's stated intent, restoring CSRF protection everywhere else without over-restricting.

R157.note: Removes the double URL-decode and adds canonicalization plus Path.startsWith containment check; the single-filename restriction matches the cookie's intended scope (a bare FileName).

R158.note: redis-py's SET correctly closes the RESP injection, but the fixed function silently returns a hardcoded "OK" string instead of the original socket/Redis response bytes - an unstated interface/behavior change.

R159.note: Path.Join + GetFullPath canonicalization + GetRelativePath containment check correctly rejects only actual traversal attempts, leaving in-bounds filenames untouched.

R160.note: ProcessBuilder with an argument array plus a hostname/IP allowlist regex (also blocking leading '-') closes both shell and flag injection without rejecting legitimate hosts.

R161.note: Per-category method allowlist restricts to exactly the one method actually exposed (email.send), closing arbitrary-method invocation without rejecting any real action defined in the case.

R162.note: th:utext to th:text applies Thymeleaf's standard HTML escaping to the note variable, closing the reflected XSS with no other observable change.

R163.note: StackExchange.Redis IDatabase.HashSet correctly RESP-frames both hash fields, preserving the same two fields (note, updated); constructor swap to IConnectionMultiplexer is the necessary vehicle for the library swap, not an extraneous restriction.

R164.note: Jakarta Mail Transport/MimeMessage with strict InternetAddress parsing closes the CRLF injection, but the write-up openly adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, a new hard requirement unrelated to this CWE that could break delivery if the internal relay doesn't support STARTTLS.

R165.note: Inserts the tar "--" end-of-options marker before filenames, exactly the pass-through-as-literal option the stated contract allows, with no effect on non-dash filenames.

R166.note: shell=False with an argument list closes the shell injection; verified empirically (subprocess.Popen with a list on Windows) that a .bat still launches directly, so legitimate use is preserved.
